blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Calawagan Mountain River Resort in Paluan reopened to visitors, but will initially operate only on weekends and accept guests from 8 a.m. to noon, the municipal government announced on Friday, Nov. 20. In a public advisory, the Paluan local government said the nature-based tourist destination would be open every Saturday and Sunday. The municipal government said repairs and improvements to some of the resort’s facilities were still ongoing, and appealed to visitors for understanding and cooperation while the work was being undertaken. Visitors were advised to observe the resort’s limited operating schedule and entry hours. […]... Keep on reading: Calawagan Mountain River Resort in Oriental Mindoro reopens to public
